title: Surprisingly STEM: Wind Tunnel Engineers
description: We’re big fans of Sam Zauber and Frank Quinto – two wind tunnel test engineers at NASA's Langley Research Center! You’ll be blown away as you learn how NASA uses its 14-foot by 22-foot subsonic wind tunnel. See some of the fascinating things Frank and Sam have tested there, and learn what propelled them into their exciting STEM careers.
keywords: Langley, Surprisingly STEM, STEM, Wind Tunnel, Engineers, Students, Educators
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
